# Travel Amin
> Arabic-language website of Amin, a tour guide based in Mashhad, Iran. It offers tourism and medical-travel coordination in Iran for Arabic-speaking travelers. Contact and booking happen directly on WhatsApp; the site has no backend and shows no fixed prices.

## Services
- Tourism: guide, airport transfer, accommodation suggestions and a daily itinerary in Mashhad, Tehran, northern Iran and nature destinations.
- Medical travel (consultation and coordination only, no medical advice and no guarantee of results): cosmetic surgery, dentistry, fertility treatment and general check-ups.

## Facts
- Based in: Mashhad, Iran
- Experience: 5 years with Arabic-speaking guests
- Language of the site: Arabic (right-to-left)
